verses.1: A good name is better than bad. And the day of death is worse than the day of birth.
verses.2: It’s better to go to the house of sorrow than to the house of drinking, when that is the end of all people. And life will be given to their hearts.
verses.3: It’s better to get angry from playing games, rather than having a good relationship with others. It’s better for the heart to be happy.
verses.4: The hearts of the wise are in the house of mourning, while the hearts of the foolish are in the house of joy.
verses.5: It is good to hear the complaints of a wise man from someone who only hears the songs of fools.
verses.6: For just as the noise of those who are under the yoke is heard beneath it, so too does the foolish person laugh. And that is also a form of gloom.
verses.7: For the blind one will praise the wise, and he will destroy the heart of those who are foolish.
verses.8: Good is that which comes from its beginning; good is something that lasts forever.
verses.9: Do not be upset in your heart, for anger is like a nest of fools.
verses.10: Don’t say that the days in the past were better than these. It’s not wise of you to ask about them.
verses.11: Goodness is wisdom, along with a generous heart; it is also more pleasing to those who see the heavens.
verses.12: For in the shadow of wisdom, in the shadow of gold, and as wisdom’s knowledge increases, so does its life.
verses.13: See what God has done! Who can repair what is broken?
verses.14: On a good day, may there be good things; on a bad day, may he also see that God has done something in response to what people do not understand.
verses.15: I have seen all this in the days of my youth. There are righteous people who are destroyed because of their righteousness, and there are wicked people who continue to do evil.
verses.16: Do not be too righteous, and do not be too patient. What’s the point of being so patient?
verses.17: Do not sin too much, and do not become foolish. Why should you die without having received your due reward?
verses.18: It is good to hold onto this, but do not also hold onto that. Do not put your hand in it, for if you do, God will take them all away from you.
verses.19: The wisdom will protect them from the ten rulers who were in the city.
verses.20: For there is no righteous man on earth who does only what is right and never commits any sin.
verses.21: And for all those things that people may say, do not listen to them. Do not believe your servant’s insults.
verses.22: For even in many times, your heart knows that you too have cursed others.
verses.23: I tried all kinds of wisdom, but it was far from me.
verses.24: Far away from what it once was, and difficult to find.
verses.25: My mothers, my heart desires to know and understand. I seek wisdom and insight. I want to recognize the wickedness of their actions, and the foolishness of their behavior.
verses.26: And I find that the woman who is so respected and honored by others, whose hands are forbidden to do good deeds, will be punished before God. She will be captured and trapped in her own sin.
verses.27: See, I found one saying after another that contained some kind of thought or idea.
verses.28: I have searched everywhere, but I couldn’t find a single man among the thousands I looked for. And among all those women, I also couldn’t find any one.
verses.29: In this way, I found out that God created man in a proper manner. And those who seek to understand His thoughts are indeed seeking too much.
